continuity.arc: Yashoda first sees the universe during an infant yawn; later, playing with boys, Krishna is accused of eating mud. Yashoda questions him and asks him to open his mouth, where the earth, many worlds, Narayana in the milk ocean, and recursive universes appear. Krishna then restores ordinary maternal affection.
continuity.style: Traditional matte South Indian temple mural: firm dark contours, broad matte mineral color fields, shallow decorative space, restrained facial modeling, painted ochre rather than metallic gold, earthy cream/maroon/olive/ochre and established deep-blue deity skin. User-supplied D046 photos guide narrative action only, never glossy finish.
